name: Appwrite
description_en:
Appwrite provides backend and hosting services for application developers: authentication, databases, file storage, functions, messaging, realtime updates and Sites. Developers call its APIs/SDKs from their own application; the service does not replace designing the user experience or business rules.

Appwrite Cloud is a managed offering, while self-hosting puts installation, backups, upgrades and capacity with the operator. The current database range includes serverless TablesDB and dedicated options. This profile focuses on a user-data application workflow, permissions, transaction failures and operating costs rather than assuming all database products behave identically.
description_zh:
Appwrite 为应用开发者提供认证、数据库、文件存储、函数、消息、实时更新及 Sites 托管。开发者从自己的应用调用 API／SDK，仍需设计用户体验及业务规则。

Appwrite Cloud 为托管服务，自托管则由运营方负责安装、备份、升级及容量。当前数据库包含 serverless TablesDB 及专用选项。本文聚焦用户数据应用流程、权限、事务失败及运行成本，不假设全部数据库产品行为相同。

core_features.explanation_en: Use client account/session APIs and application auth-state handling.
core_features.explanation_zh: 使用客户端账号／会话 API 并管理应用认证状态。

core_features.explanation_en: Control table/row access with user/team grants and Row Security settings.
core_features.explanation_zh: 结合用户／团队授权及 Row Security 管理表／行访问。

core_features.explanation_en: Stage related row operations, commit atomically and detect conflicts.
core_features.explanation_zh: 暂存相关行操作，原子提交并检测冲突。

core_features.explanation_en: Choose managed service or operate the Docker-based stack and recovery yourself.
core_features.explanation_zh: 选择托管服务，或自行运行 Docker 栈及恢复。

steps.zh: 接真实用户前测试事务冲突并检查额度及备份恢复。

review_notes: Original AI research draft based on the cited public official pages; no publication, price approval, independent review or product test is implied.
Earlier third-party feature and price claims are retained only in discovery provenance, not as current product evidence.

sections.title_en: Create a private-data journey, not only a login screen
sections.title_zh: 构建私有数据流程，不只登录页
sections.en: A proposed notes application could create an account/session, create a note and let its owner retrieve it. Auth-state checks redirect unauthenticated users in the frontend; database grants decide which records can be accessed. Test a second signed-in account and a logged-out client against the same note. Hiding a route or button is not proof that direct API access is denied. The suggested calls and accounts were not created during this research.
sections.zh: 建议以笔记应用试验：创建账号／会话、创建笔记、让所有者读取。前端认证状态检查负责跳转，数据库授权决定记录访问。需让另一已登录账号及未登录客户端访问同笔记；隐藏路由或按钮不能证明 API 直连被拒。本研究未创建这些账号或请求。

sections.title_en: A broad table grant can override your isolation intention
sections.title_zh: 宽泛表授权可能破坏隔离意图
sections.en: Database access is granted at table OR row level, not only when both allow it. Row-level rules apply only with Row Security enabled. Therefore adding a private row grant does not restrict an already broad table read grant. The general permission guide also distinguishes defaults: Client SDK creation grants the creator read/update/delete, while Console/Server creation without explicit permissions leaves an empty grant set. Verify the exact creation path and resulting permissions before treating every new record as private to its owner.
sections.zh: 数据库访问按表或行授权，不要求两层同时允许；行规则仅在启用 Row Security 后应用。因此，行的私有授权不能限制既有宽泛表读取。通用指南还区分默认值：Client SDK 创建会给创建者读／更新／删除，Console／Server 未显式授权则为空。认定新记录均属所有者私有前，应核对创建路径及最终权限。

sections.title_en: Server keys are a different trust boundary
sections.title_zh: 服务端密钥是另一信任边界
sections.en: With appropriate API-key scopes, a Server SDK can access resources regardless of their resource permissions. A project user, in contrast, can grant only access they already hold; trying to share to an unrelated team can fail with 401. If a function performs privileged sharing, validate its caller and requested target rather than assuming row permissions protect that code path. Resource helpers also differ: create permission is for tables/buckets, not rows/files in the general guide. No server-key access or security test was executed.
sections.zh: 带相应 API key scope 的 Server SDK 可不受资源权限限制访问；项目用户则只能授自己持有的访问，向无关团队分享可能返回 401。若函数执行提权分享，需校验调用者及目标，不能假设行权限保护该路径。资源助手也不同：通用指南中 create 权限用于表／bucket，不用于行／文件。本次未执行服务端密钥访问或安全测试。

sections.title_en: Staged database work can fail at commit
sections.title_zh: 暂存的数据库操作可能在提交时失败
sections.en: Transactions stage supported row/bulk/numeric operations until commit and can span databases/tables. Schema changes are excluded. Affected rows changed externally cause a conflict; the guide suggests refetching and re-staging. Plan caps are 100 operations for Free, 1,000 Pro and 2,500 Scale. A proposed two-row transfer should verify success, a deliberate concurrent edit and rollback of staged work. Database atomicity does not include an email, payment or arbitrary external API call; do not replay those side effects just because a database commit failed.
sections.zh: 事务暂存支持的行／批量／数值操作，提交前不改目标表，可跨数据库／表，但不含 schema 修改。受影响行在外部变化会触发冲突，指南建议重取并重新暂存。方案上限为 Free 一百、Pro 一千、Scale 两千五百操作。建议双行转移试验检查成功、并发修改及撤销暂存；数据库原子性不含邮件、支付或外部 API，不能因提交失败就直接重放副作用。

sections.title_en: Self-hosting includes recovery of more than a database
sections.title_zh: 自托管恢复不只数据库
sections.en: The installer guide requires Docker Compose 2, at least two CPU cores, 4 GB RAM and 2 GB swap; these are installation minima, not capacity guarantees. Self-hosted backups include database, volumes and configuration. The backup guide says stop Appwrite for consistent volume backups, restore only into a fresh installation and preserve the exact _APP_OPENSSL_KEY_V1 or encrypted data becomes inaccessible. Test a disposable restore before relying on backups. The site markets open source, but the complete software/license-component inventory was not reviewed here.
sections.zh: 安装指南要求 Docker Compose 2、至少双核、4 GB RAM、2 GB swap，这些是安装最低值，不是容量保证。自托管需备份数据库、卷及配置。备份指南要求停 Appwrite 以保证卷一致，只恢复到全新安装，并保留相同 _APP_OPENSSL_KEY_V1，否则加密数据无法访问。依赖备份前应测试可丢弃恢复。官网称开源，但本次未审阅完整软件／许可组件清单。

sections.title_en: Base subscription and database compute are different charges
sections.title_zh: 基础订阅与数据库算力是不同费用
sections.en: The current pricing page offers serverless database compute with no fixed fee but quotas/overages, or dedicated compute from $10/database/month. HA replicas cost another full tier; point-in-time recovery adds 20% of base. These are database figures, not the whole organization subscription. Base plan cards were missing in both the readable page and rendered browser, so no remembered Pro starting price is supplied. Confirm subscription, project count, storage/network, reads/writes and backup options together before estimating a bill.
sections.zh: 当前定价页提供 serverless 数据库无固定算力费但有额度／超额，或专用算力每数据库每月 $10 起。HA 副本另收完整层级费用，时间点恢复加基础价 20%。这是数据库费用，不是完整组织订阅。可读页及渲染浏览器均未显示基础方案卡，因此不采用记忆中的 Pro 起价。应一并确认订阅、项目数、存储／网络、读写及备份选项再估价。

sections.title_en: A spending cap can turn into an availability limit
sections.title_zh: 费用上限也可能成为可用性限制
sections.en: Plans apply to organizations, with resources allocated per project. Pro automatically buys extra resources until the budget cap; the billing guide says bandwidth exhaustion at the cap can deny API access. Storage exhaustion disables uploads and persists until usage falls below the limit. The pricing FAQ says Free over-limit projects freeze with read-only Console until upgrade, resource removal or a reset where applicable. Monitor resource-specific behavior rather than assuming every limit resets identically or that a cap preserves full availability.
sections.zh: 方案归组织，资源按项目分配。Pro 自动购买额外资源直至预算上限；计费指南说明达到上限后带宽耗尽可拒绝 API。存储耗尽会禁用上传，需降至限制以下。定价 FAQ 说明 Free 超限项目冻结、Console 只读，需升级、移除资源或在适用时等待重置。应监控具体资源行为，不能假设全部限制同样重置，或费用封顶仍保持完整可用性。
